rationale: C20 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both directives suspend promotion-related provisions for specified Navy staff corps, preserve one quoted provision through an opening “Except as to” clause, limit the suspension “to the extent” applicable to named corps or grades, and use the identical termination formula tied to June 30 of the fiscal year following the end of the December 16, 1950 national emergency. C17 is closely related because it suspends part of the same statutory section and promotion machinery, but its operative sentence and fixed expiration are less similar. C07 shares the emergency-linked suspension formula but concerns different statutory provisions and lacks the distinctive exception structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Except as to the provision which ... reads ... the provisions of section 5762 (a) ... to the extent that such provisions are applicable to promotions ... are hereby suspended
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Except as to the provision which reads ... the operation of the provisions of paragraph (2) of section 308 (b) ... to the extent that such provisions are applicable to the Medical Corps and Dental Corps is hereby suspended
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive parallel operative construction: a quoted statutory exception followed by a targeted suspension limited through “to the extent” language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: until June 30 of the fiscal year following that in which the national emergency proclaimed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of December 16, 1950, shall end
shared_material.parent_excerpt: until June 30 of the fiscal year following that in which the national emergency proclaimed by [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of December 16, 1950, shall end
shared_material.explanation: The termination clause is identical and completes the same legal mechanism.

shared_material.child_excerpt: officers ... recommended for promotion to the grade of captain or commander in the Medical Corps, the Supply Corps, the Chaplain Corps, the Civil Engineer Corps, Dental Corps, or the Medical Service Corps
shared_material.parent_excerpt: temporary promotion of officers not restricted in the performance of duty to the grades of captain and commander ... applicable to the Medical Corps and Dental Corps
shared_material.explanation: Both address the number or promotion of unrestricted-duty officers to captain or commander in specialized Navy corps, indicating adaptation of the earlier machinery to a revised statutory provision and set of corps.
